approach: One live extraction pass after setup (setup itself the apply of a decision requiring authoring-track), merging extracted values and lookup defaults into the 088 decisionStore - seed unanswered, offered beside answered, validate-rejects absent; the five FR-002 seeders converted to module extracts/defaults and deleted as write paths; the series acceptance test (US1) verified by a both-tracks Playwright walk in pnpm dev.

decisions.decision: Reuse runDecisionFlow's per-module semantics (order, validate-rejects-are-absent, source naming) in a new live runner that merges into decisionStore, rather than forking semantics
decisions.rejected: adopting runDecisionFlow's output wholesale after setup (would overwrite author answers, violating US2 scenario 2)
decisions.why: FR-001/US2 semantics already exist and are tested; the gap is wiring and merge rules (seed vs offered), which runDecisionFlow's whole-flow pure pass does not have

decisions.decision: Setup is the apply of a decision requiring base-keyboard and authoring-track (HANDOFF G7's 'instantiate requires authoring-track'), running once with the track known
decisions.rejected: reordering the track step before choose_base in step placement (placement is 091's derived output, and selection legitimately precedes the track - instantiation is what must wait)
decisions.why: FR-004; fixes the verified StudioShell hazard structurally (first commit new-from-base, refresh discards the survey) instead of patching doCommit

decisions.decision: Track-dependent seeding disposition for copyright-holder is a generic pass mechanism reading the decision's inputs, not a module special case

decisions.why: US1 permits exactly one declaration edit; the adapt-seeds/copy-defaults behaviour follows from authoring-track being a declared input (088 FR-001 inputs snapshot)
